title: MedOrqis-LLM: Bilingual (Arabic/English) Medical Foundation Model & Clinical Tool-Calling Brain
description: MedOrqis-LLM is a bilingual clinical foundation model fine-tuned for high-stakes medical reasoning, diagnostic decision support, and deterministic tool-calling. Proprietary intellectual property of Eng. Tarek Mohamed (Tarek Khallaf). Patent & Copyright Pending.
